WITH patient_metrics AS (
  SELECT 
    ID,
    AVG(CAST(HGB AS FLOAT) / CAST(HCT AS FLOAT)) as avg_ratio,
    AVG(PIC) as avg_pic
  FROM Laboratory
  WHERE HGB IS NOT NULL AND HCT IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY ID
),
overall_stats AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) as overall_avg_ratio
  FROM patient_metrics
),
filtered_patients AS (
  SELECT 
    pm.ID,
    pm.avg_pic,
    pm.avg_ratio,
    (pm.avg_ratio - os.overall_avg_ratio) as excess
  FROM patient_metrics pm
  CROSS JOIN overall_stats os
  WHERE pm.avg_ratio > os.overall_avg_ratio
)
SELECT 
  AVG(avg_pic) as avg_of_avg_pic,
  AVG(avg_ratio) as avg_of_ratios,
  AVG(excess) as avg_excess
FROM filtered_patients
